name: Webhook
description: Sends each event to a web address as JSON, signed so the receiver can check it came from ZiraHive. Use it with Home Assistant, n8n, Node-RED or your own scripts.
author: ZiraHive

settings.label: Signing secret
settings.help: Each request carries X-ZiraHive-Signature: sha256=<HMAC of the body with this secret>

settings.label: Events
settings.help: Comma-separated, or * for all: file.uploaded, media.added, backup.finished, party.created, user.created
